name: Awareness heat map
what: Tags every ad, post, email and page we run, and every competitor ad, by awareness level (unaware, problem aware, solution aware, product aware, most aware) and funnel stage. Weights by spend and shows where we are thin, per platform, next to competitors.
inputs: our ads with spend and results (Meta, Google, TikTok)
competitor ads from the Ad Library by page id
a written rubric with 5 examples per level
powers: share of spend by awareness level
gap to competitors by level
which level has the cheapest new customers
what to make next and where to find inspiration for it
Google search terms split top, middle and bottom of funnel
note: Levels of awareness across your brand and are you servicing it vs competitors

name: Past creative archive
what: One place with every ad we have run: the media, the copy, spend, results, dates, audience and placement, sortable and searchable. Dynamic and mixed creatives flagged.
inputs: Meta and TikTok ad history with media
powers: find past winners in seconds
stop remaking ads that already failed
raw material for tags, postmortems and variants
note: Easy to use interface for past creatives

name: Creative decomposition tags
what: Breaks each ad into parts: hook, angle, pain point, avatar, awareness level, format, length, first frame, proof type, offer, CTA, talent, setting. Same tags on our ads, competitor ads and the inspiration library, so they can be matched.
inputs: tag list with definitions and examples
a person to check 20 tags a week
powers: what winning ads share
tags that lose money
match a winner to library ads with the same tags
tag coverage gaps
note: Based on creatives which have worked in the past, decomposed and mapped to the database of creatives. Create tags for each and match tags

name: Why-it-worked matcher
what: Takes a winning ad's tags and checks them against the idea bank, the knowledge cards and the inspiration library. States the principle it followed, with a test anyone can repeat, and flags claims it cannot verify.
powers: a plain reason each winner won
principles to reuse in new concepts
principles that do not hold for this brand
note: Understand what made that creative work. Compare that against databases

name: Variant builder
what: From one winner, makes near variants (new hook, new first frame, new length) and far variants (new angle, new avatar, new format) that keep the principle. Labels each as near or far.
powers: a weekly batch of variants tied to a reason
a split of near and far bets
note: Create variants some similar some different

name: Script builder
what: Writes ad scripts from a principle, an avatar and a pain point: hook options, body, proof, CTA, with shot notes. Produces variations of the script.
inputs: avatar and pain points from the brain
powers: scripts for UGC, founder, AI video and static storyboards
a script bank linked to results
note: Create into variants and new concepts mapped to the best practices that the winning ad followed scripts available too

name: AI video stack
what: Takes one script, makes 3 to 5 variations, cuts each to 15, 30 and 30 to 45 seconds, renders with a video tool, and lays out the grid so one cut per stack is picked to launch.
inputs: access to a video tool such as Higgsfield
powers: more video tests per week at a lower cost per test
which length wins for this brand

name: Best segment map
what: Shows which age, gender, placement and region buy at the lowest cost per new customer, per creative and per tag. Tells the writer who the ad is for.
inputs: Meta and TikTok breakdowns by age, gender, placement, region
powers: tailor copy and creative to the best segment
spot placements that burn money
spot segments no ad speaks to
note: Copy and creative will be tailored to the best performing segment of the population (age/gender/placement)

name: Format translator
what: Takes a principle that worked in one format and rewrites it for others: static, carousel, UGC video, founder video, native article, email, landing page block.
powers: more formats from one proven idea
native and advertorial ads for top of funnel
note: Recommends different formats following the same principles

name: Competitor feed
what: Pulls competitor ads (Ad Library by page id) and organic posts on a schedule, records how long each ad has run, and tags them. Long-running ads are treated as signals, never as proven winners.
inputs: list of competitors with page ids and handles
powers: what rivals push and at which awareness level
new launches and offers the day they appear
principles to test in our own words
note: Feed in competition. Look through their organic content + ads library and get ideas from there. Convert those ideas into base principles

name: Swipe file with notes
what: A saved library of ads and posts anyone on the team can clip, with a short note on why it was saved and which tag or gap it fills.
powers: inspiration filtered by awareness level, format or angle
notes that turn into briefs
note: AdLibNote. Muse for content on meta

name: Creative postmortem
what: For each ad that lost money: spend, reach, who saw it (age, gender, placement), where people dropped (thumb stop, hold, click, page, cart), and the likely cause. Ends with a fix and a relaunch plan, or a kill note.
powers: fix and relaunch instead of starting from zero
a record of what fails for this brand
note: Postmortem of bad creatives with really good context on spend and demographic data and how you can improve and relaunch

name: Creator and partnership roster
what: A list of creators and partners with fit, rates, rights, content delivered and the results of partnership ads run through their handles.
powers: which creators sell
whitelisting and partnership ads
renewals and cuts
note: Influencer marketing and partnership ads

name: Copy decomposition by avatar and pain
what: Splits every ad and page into avatar, pain point, promise, proof and CTA, and counts spend and results for each avatar and pain pair.
inputs: avatar list and pain points from the brain
powers: which avatar and pain pairs sell
pairs we never speak to
copy briefs per pair
note: Ad copy decomposition based on avatar and pain point

name: Cross-channel signal bridge
what: Moves proven words and angles between channels: Google search terms, Amazon reviews and questions, site search and tickets into Meta hooks, and Meta winners into Google ads, SEO and pages.
powers: hooks in the customer's own words
new keyword and article ideas from ad winners
note: Funnel Google insights/amazon reviews/search data into meta ads and vice versa

name: Review miner
what: Reads our reviews and competitors' reviews (site, Amazon, marketplaces), groups what people love, hate and wish for, and counts each theme.
inputs: competitor reviews on Amazon and their sites
powers: claims and objections to use in ads and pages
product fixes
where rivals fail and we can win
note: Competitor review mining - get insights on what doesn't work or what's working and incorporate it into your marketing

name: Question coverage matrix
what: Lists every question customers ask (tickets, chat, Amazon Q&A, reviews, search) and marks where it is answered: product page, FAQ, ad, email, help centre. Blank cells are the work.
powers: fewer tickets
higher conversion from answered objections
article and FAQ briefs
note: Coverage matrix from customer tickets amazon

name: Ticket clock
what: Tracks first reply time, time to resolution, follow-ups owed and reopen rate per ticket, with the order value at stake.
powers: no customer left waiting
which issues cost the most
staffing needs
note: Follow up and time to resolution of tickets

name: VIP list
what: Ranks customers by value and recency, picks the top slice, and runs quiet perks: a personal letter, early access, a private offer. Tracks who got what and what they did next.
powers: repeat rate of top customers
referrals
early reads on new products
note: Sending personal letters to high value clients /vip clients giving them special access be secretive about it

name: Page behaviour map
what: Joins scroll depth, heatmaps and recordings (Clarity or similar) with GA4 funnels per page and device, and names where shoppers stop.
powers: the one block to fix on each money page
CRO test ideas with evidence
note: Scroll depth and clarity/GA insights to drive CRO changes

name: Ad to page congruence check
what: For each ad with spend, compares the ad's promise, offer, visual and awareness level with the page it lands on and scores the match. Flags ads whose page breaks the promise.
powers: fix the page for the best ads first
new pages for winning angles
fewer bounces from paid traffic
note: Ad changes linked to landing pages. Congruence of ad + LP. Ad to landing page congruence of best ads to promote best practices

name: App and code audit
what: Lists every installed app and script, whether it is still used, what it costs a month, and how much it slows pages. Ties the slowdown to lost revenue.
inputs: store admin app list and billing
powers: apps to remove
monthly savings
revenue lost to slow pages
note: Old app code deleted are you using these tie to revenue lost

name: Theme twin test
what: Duplicates the live theme, makes the speed or flow change on the copy, tests both (speed and a checkout walk-through), and merges only when the copy wins.
powers: safe speed fixes
no broken checkout on a Friday
note: Duplicate and test speed on both. Test flow and then merge

name: Win and loss ledger
what: Every test gets a result. A win is promoted to the standard (T0) that all new work starts from. A loss writes a fail note with why. Sets the date to recheck each rule.
powers: what works for this brand, with proof
no repeated failed tests
standards that expire when they stop working
note: Win promotes to T0 loss writes a fail when to check what all things work and what doesn't

name: Search and answer engine feed
what: Pulls Search Console, SEO tool data and answer engine checks (what ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity say about us and the category).
inputs: an SEO data source such as OpenSEO
a list of buyer questions to ask assistants
powers: queries rising and falling
pages losing clicks
where assistants mention rivals and not us
note: Openseo geo GSC mcp

name: Article brief builder
what: Builds SEO article briefs from Search Console gaps, ad winners, search terms, reviews and tickets, with the question, the angle, the proof and the product link.
powers: articles that answer real questions and sell
content for answer engines
note: Also SEO focused articles can be built from Google insights, meta ads data and search data/reviews

name: Marketplace plan
what: A per-channel plan for Amazon, TikTok Shop and quick commerce: listings, pricing floor, ads, reviews, stock and fees, with margin per unit after fees.
inputs: Seller Central and TikTok Shop data
powers: which SKUs to list where
margin per channel
listing fixes
note: Amazon seller and tiktok shop strategy

name: Brain intake and split
what: Takes everything we ingest (site, ads, reviews, tickets, documents, interviews) and files it onto the brain's shelves, linked like a graph: product to claim to proof to avatar to ad.
powers: every agent starts from the same facts
find the proof for any claim in one step
note: Main ingestion and split - splits into categories accordingly think like a graph. Choose a brand first build brand brain then select appropriate creatives landing pages etc

name: Customer jobs map
what: Finds why customers hire the product: the moment, the progress wanted, what they used before, what nearly stopped them. From reviews, tickets, post-purchase surveys and a few interviews.
powers: angles and hooks from real moments
new audiences in other moments
product and bundle ideas
note: Jobs to be done why are they hiring

name: Work board
what: A kanban board of every task from every screen: to do, doing, waiting on approval, live, measured. Each card links to the job, owner, due date and the metric it should move.
powers: nothing lost between screens and people
who is overloaded
what shipped and what it did
note: Kanban board

name: Security folder
what: A register of every account, who has access, 2-step status, and the recovery path, plus a folder for policies and incident notes. Holds no passwords itself.
powers: no lost access when someone leaves
fast recovery after a takeover
note: Security folder

name: Funnel stage mix
what: Splits spend and results by funnel stage on every channel: prospecting vs retargeting on Meta, generic vs brand search on Google, new vs returning buyers.
powers: are we buying new customers or rebuying old ones
brand search inflation
where to add top of funnel spend
note: Levels of awareness across your brand ... top of funnel, middle of funnel, bottom of funnel

name: Margin view
what: Gross profit per order, per product and per channel after product cost, shipping, fees, discounts and returns.
powers: which ads and offers make money, not just revenue
floors for cost per purchase

name: Market pulse
what: Quarter by quarter view of the category: search demand, marketplace sales rank, competitor launches, input costs and allied categories, next to our own growth.
powers: is the category growing and are we keeping pace
costs about to rise
trends to catch early
